regression.details: ISHRAT and GINIPT both describe income inequality. Both are derived from the income distribution of a country. They are somewhat correlated: enough so that ISHRAT is a reasonable predictor of GINIPT in the absence of GINIPT data, but not so much that we feel we should only use ISHRAT data to measure income inequality. We use a simple linear regression model to predict GINIPT from ISHRAT data.
